verdict: No concrete scientific correctness blockers found in the reviewed source.
v4_vs_v3: evaluate77.py changes only the required packet directory; export scientific try block is unchanged. Other changes adapt stage/historical-family metadata checks to authorized normal runtime. All frozen science/data/launcher source hashes match their pinned manifests.

checks.detail: Hits@50 uses the 50th-largest score in the common unchanged 100000-negative pool and a strict positive > threshold test, matching the pinned OGB evaluator. No per-edge negative ranking, filtering, or sigmoid-before-pooling is substituted.

Every arm/seed uses one frozen train/valid cache, fixed shared training negatives, official validation/test negatives, and the qualified weighted training-only graph. Finalization rechecks graph/features and uses retained common hashes/cards; validation or test topology is not added. Authentic test order is checked exactly.

Only launcher_v3/root_family_v2 is admitted: five arms x seeds0/1/2, 100 consecutive epochs, 15 cells, 24 optimizer fits, successful terminal receipt. Earliest exact maximum validation Hits@50 selects one checkpoint per cell. Independent4 members are selected synchronously by pooled validation performance. Ledger, identity, checkpoint bytes, envelope and state are bound. Earlier partial family is excluded.

Arithmetic raw-logit mean is computed on the evaluation device across four within-cell members for factorized4/independent4; single arms have one member. The three seeds remain separate replicate cells. Export reuses source batching/hydration/model paths and device-side mean, then requires exact scalar primary Hits@50 agreement.

Shared graph, candidate order, training-negative cache, and seed labels support same-seed arm comparisons. Batch-order seeds are paired; exact dropout masks are explicitly not paired. The source does not calculate arm differences or comparison summaries. Export preserves arm/seed labels and common candidate ordering.

No paired interval, hypothesis test, calibration estimate, or seed-uncertainty computation exists in evaluation/export v4. Raw member logits permit later descriptive ensemble-dispersion analysis and the three matched seed cells permit paired descriptive differences. Four ensemble members and shared graph edges are not independent seed replicates. Three seeds support the registered representative practical screen and transparent effect/range reporting, not precise population uncertainty or general superiority claims. This does not block completing/reporting the pilot.

One common candidate-order file and 15 member/pooled envelopes bind frozen source/config/cache, exact selected checkpoint, family lock, test/order and primary scalar result hashes. Checkpoints/results are rehashed before/after replay. Evidence replay is separately charged and does not claim to be saved primary-forward tensors or improve timing.

limitations: Static source review and file-byte/hash verification only; no Python/model source or tests executed.
No real archive member, split, label, tensor, checkpoint state, score, or GPU output opened.
The parent reports training is still in progress. This review does not certify actual family completion, runtime execution, numerical agreement, outcomes, or downstream uncertainty analysis.
Existing source closure checks must encounter the completed actual family before evaluation; no new admission or filesystem control is proposed.
recommended_action: Proceed with the existing registered pilot schedule and source deployment; after actual full closure use the existing evaluation/export stages. No source repair requested by this review.
